preconditions.description: Input is an integer n that is a multiple of 4 and within the range [4, 1000].

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(num) <= int(n)**2 - 1 for row in stdout.splitlines() for num in row.split())
postconditions.description: All integers in the output grid are unique and within the range [0, n² - 1].

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == int(n) and all(len(row.split()) == int(n) for row in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The output is a square matrix of size n × n.

postconditions.expression: len(set(num for row in stdout.splitlines() for num in row.split())) == int(n)**2
postconditions.description: All integers from 0 to n² - 1 appear exactly once in the grid.

postconditions.expression: (lambda rows: all((lambda row: reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, map(int, row.split()))) == reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, map(int, rows[0].split())) for row in rows))(stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in each row is the same.

postconditions.expression: (lambda grid: all((lambda col: reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, [int(grid[i].split()[col]) for i in range(int(n))])) == reduce(lambda x, y: x ^ y, [int(grid[0].split()[0]) for i in range(int(n))]) for col in range(int(n))))(stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in each column is the same.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[j]) ^ int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[j+1]) ^ ... ^ int(stdout.splitlines()[i].split()[j+int(n)-1]) == xor_value for j in range(int(n)))
postconditions.description: The bitwise XOR of all elements in each column is the same (denoted as xor_value).
